blocks.text:
To: Mary Frank
Cc: Michelle Rose
Good to have the two figures back, thank you. That clears the last open lines, and the {{fact:f:E-2017-001.client}} draft now reads the way we discussed at kickoff.
Michelle Rose is preparing the clean version and the messaging map that sits under it. We will keep both in one place so your team is never working from an old copy.
I would like thirty minutes with the three of us to walk the map before it goes any wider. Send a couple of windows that work this week and I will set the meeting.
